name: Optimize AudioEngine player selection lock performance

description: Baseline NSLock performance: 0.1044 µs per acquire (single-threaded). os_unfair_lock shows 1.1x improvement in benchmark.

asi.hypothesis: NSLock overhead is minimal but os_unfair_lock is the modern recommended API with lower memory footprint
asi.note: Single-threaded test shows modest improvement; actual benefit is lower memory and better contention handling

description: Replace NSLock with os_unfair_lock in AudioEngine. Lock acquisition: 0.099 µs. Modern API with lower memory footprint and better contention handling.

asi.hypothesis: os_unfair_lock is the recommended modern API with better performance characteristics than NSLock
asi.notes: Single-threaded test shows modest improvement; primary benefit is modern API adoption and lower overhead

name: Move audio profile loading off main thread

description: Baseline synchronous profile load: 0.462 ms. Small WAV files load quickly, but this blocks the calling thread and doesn't scale to larger sample packs.

asi.hypothesis: Synchronous profile loading blocks thread; async loading with completion handler would improve responsiveness
asi.note: Baseline is already fast (0.46ms) due to small WAV files, but design doesn't scale
